name: veles-bykovuna-fuels
description: Root orchestrator for the Veles Bykovuna Fuels ERP — build and (re)start the NestJS backend + Next.js frontend under PM2 from one place.

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.deploy: npm run build && pm2 restart all
scripts.deploy:reload: npm run build && pm2 startOrReload ecosystem.config.js && pm2 save
